old_caption: The video captures a dimly lit scene featuring two prominent lanterns. The first lantern, positioned on the left side of the frame, is black with a clear glass globe that encases a bright, steady electric bulb. This lantern is mounted on a metal stand and is upright. To its right, there is a red lantern with a curved handle and a red body, also equipped with a clear glass globe that contains a steady, bright light. The background is cluttered with various items, including what appears to be a coiled hose or cable on the left and some cylindrical objects stacked horizontally above the lanterns. The lighting is low, creating a moody atmosphere, and the focus remains primarily on the two lanterns throughout the sequence. There are no visible characters or animals in the scene, and the camera remains stationary, maintaining a consistent angle and framing of the lanterns and their surroundings.
original_wisa_caption: The video captures a dimly lit scene featuring two prominent lanterns. The first lantern, positioned on the left side of the frame, is black with a clear glass globe that encases a bright, flickering flame. This lantern is mounted on a metal stand and is slightly tilted to the right. To its right, there is a red lantern with a curved handle and a dark body, also equipped with a clear glass globe that contains a steady, warm light. The background is cluttered with various items, including what appears to be a coiled hose or cable on the left and some cylindrical objects stacked horizontally above the lanterns. The lighting is low, creating a moody atmosphere, and the focus remains primarily on the two lanterns throughout the sequence. There are no visible characters or animals in the scene, and the camera remains stationary, maintaining a consistent angle and framing of the lanterns and their surroundings.
caption: The video captures a close-up of a burning lantern whose glass chimney surrounds an intensely bright, overexposed flame that flickers and swells in shape throughout the clip. To the right stands a red metal lantern with a curved handle and a thin wire guard, remaining unlit while it shifts slightly against the dim background as the handheld camera drifts. Behind the lanterns, horizontal white tubes and a wooden panel form a cluttered, low-lit setting, with dark objects and a faint brand marking visible on the left. The flame's glare washes over the curved glass, softening and sharpening as the light fluctuates from frame to frame. Small changes in perspective make the red lantern and the tubes slide a little within the frame, but the solid objects do not move on their own. The bright core of the fire continues to pulse and change outline without ever stabilizing. The lantern continues to burn steadily in the same position through the final frame.
